effect_description_eng: [On Play] [When Digivolving] By returning 3 cards with the [D-Brigade] or [DigiPolice] trait from your trash to the top of the deck, for the turn, this Digimon gains ＜Rush＞ (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play.) and can't be blocked.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] All of your other Digimon with the [D-Brigade] or [DigiPolice] trait get +1000 DP.
